text: The statutory notice, its type, its sent date, its barcode, its callback date and its delivery status stay in rwb-comms' table notice in rwb_comms, and the WIN proof of delivery stays in rwb-source-data's read over v_ace_pod; rwb-asset stores none of them and carries the noticeId, the barcode, the delivery status and the callback date as references on the stage answer and the decision record only.
why: The context pack gives S5 two tables, asset_sale and listing, and no notice, pod or contact row; the TSD S5 T3.1 data model has no notice object and T3.2 has none of LOV-NOTICE, LOV-DELIVERY or LOV-SENT-TYPE; the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary defines notice as DF-LEG-015 to DF-LEG-023 with document_id referencing the P5 document, and the WIN fields map to pod_receipt and v_ace_pod, which only rwb-source-data may read. A notice column in rwb_asset would be a new table that no source authorises.
